name: multiply-operation-test-50bdc62cff/multiply-operation-p.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
## Operators: Multiplicative ops `*`, `%`, `/`; Additive ops `+`, `-`; numeric ops `+`, `-`
reason: The case expects a panic when multiplying -1 by the minimum signed integer (-9223372036854775807 - 1). Integer multiplication, subtraction, unary negation, numeric literals, local declarations and function calls are all supported; overflow behavior is part of the supported arithmetic operation, with no applicable restriction excluding it.
test_design_notes: The // @panic marker asserts runtime overflow rejection; main invokes the overflowing operation.
